task_description: Write a method in Dafny to reverse each string in a given list of string values.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ReverseEachString(strs: seq<string>) returns (result: seq<string>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The length of the resulting sequence is equal to the length of the input sequence
- Each string in the resulting sequence is the reverse of the corresponding string in the input sequence
- The order of strings in the sequence remains the same
